title: Do the Thing You Moved to Tomorrow
description: You have pushed it to tomorrow three times now. It is probably eleven minutes long.

title: Scan Something You're Buying
description: At the store, point the camera at the barcode of whatever is already in your hand. We only check the barcode is real, not what it is.

title: Scan the Book You Owe Someone
description: The library copy, or the paperback a friend lent you in spring. Scan the barcode on the back, then put it by the door.

title: Put It by the Door
description: Whatever has to leave the house tomorrow, set it on the floor in front of the door and photograph it there.

title: Fill Your Bottle Somewhere That Is Not Home
description: There is a public tap or a fountain closer than you think. Find it, fill something, and drink it standing up.

title: Give the Book Back Today
description: Take the library book to the building it belongs to, and scan its barcode on the way in.

title: Buy It From the Small Place Instead
description: Whatever you were going to get from the big shop, get it from the small one two streets over. Scan it once it is in your hand.
